title: Minimum speed value
description: Essential: The response must state or derive the minimum speed as 1.0 × 10⁶ m/s.

title: Maximum speed value
description: Essential: The response must state or derive the maximum speed as 5.0 × 10⁶ m/s.

title: Longest time value
description: Essential: The response must state or derive the longest duration as 3.14 × 10⁻⁶ s.

title: Geometry for radii
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply geometry to find the minimum (1 m) and maximum (5 m) radii of the circular trajectories.

title: Lorentz force relation
description: Important: The solution must apply the formula v = qBR/m to relate speed to the trajectory radius.

title: Time from motion period
description: Important: For the longest time, the solution must connect the time to half the period (T/2) of the circular motion.

title: Correct charge sign usage
description: Pitfall: Deduct points if the negative sign of the charge leads to an incorrect direction of force or affects the speed magnitude calculation.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution demonstrates consistent use of SI units throughout the calculation.
